title: add to brain app option to have Opus 5 as well as model sele

messages.content: add to brain app option to have Opus 5 as well as model selection

That second check was invalid for an HTML file (expected), but `server.js` syntax is confirmed fine. Added "Opus 5" (`claude-opus-5`) to the model dropdown in `crs-brain/public/index.html:1512` and to the `modelNice` label map at `crs-brain/public/index.html:2081`. Its cost falls under the existing `opus` rate fallback in `server.js`, so no pricing table change was needed.
